name: MiniTruco
tagline: Play the popular Brazilian card game Truco
description:
MiniTruco brings the popular Brazilian card game Truco to your phone. Play against the computer or with friends, following the traditional rules and bluffing tactics that make Truco such a fun, fast-paced card game.

It's a labor of love from a Brazilian developer, built to keep the game playable for everyone, free and open source.
